name: City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, May 27, 2015 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Proclamation declaring the Month of May 2015 as "Farm Fresh Month"
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Adjourned Regular City Council Meeting held on May 12, 2015
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Resolution 2015-22, Approving the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll
Item #7c
d.
Request for two hour parking on the west side of Eshelman Avenue south of Pacific Coast Highway
ACTION: Adopt a 2-hour parking restriction between the hours of 7:00 a.m. and
6:00 p.m., excluding holidays, on the west side of Eshelman Avenue
between the south curb line of Pacific Coast Highway and a point 180 feet
southerly.
Item #7d
e.
Lease Agreement with Golden State Water Company of 750acre feet of the City's unused FY 2014-15 groundwater pumping rights.
ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to execute a lease agreement with Golden State Water Company to least 750 acre feet of the City's unused Fy 2014-15 groundwater pumping rights.
Item #7e
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS RELATIVE TO THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO BE HELD ON NOVEMBER 3, 2015
Presented by City Clerk Medina
ACTION: That the following resolutions be approved:
1)
Res. 2015-23 - A resolution calling for the holding of a General Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2015 for the election of certain officers as required by the provisions of the laws of the State of California relating to General Law Cities; and
2)
Res. 2015-24 - A resolution requesting the Board of Supervisors of the Count of Los Angeles to render specific services to the City relating to the conduct of a General Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2015; and
3)
Res. 2015-25 - A resolution providing for the conduct of a Special Runoff Election for elective officers in the event of a tie vote at any municipal election.
Item #8
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
9.
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ESTABLISHING CITYWIDE COMPEHENSIVE USER FEES AND CHARGES
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
ACTION: Adopt a resolution implementing the fee schedule effective July 2015.
Item #9
10.
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING AN ENGINEER'S REPORT FOR LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT NO. 1 ANNUAL ASSESSMENT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2015-16 AND EXTENSION OF MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT WITH TOYO LANDSCAPING COMPANY
Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy
ACTION: 1) After conducting the public hearing, adopt a resolution approving the Engineer's Report for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1 for FY 2015-16 with no proposed change to the assessment; and 2) approve a one year extension to an agreement with Toyo Landscaping Company to maintain improvements within Landscape Maintenance District No. 1.
Item #10
11.
ADJOURNMENT The Lomita City Council will be adjourning to an Adjourned Regular Meeting to be held on June 1, 2015 at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers for a Budget meeting.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
